title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1982-05-23
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Pristine sound‑board recording of the May 23 1982 Greek Theatre show with a tight Ship of Fools→Estimated Prophet→Eyes of the World run and clean mix that captures Brent’s Harley mic‑up and Mickey’s drum‑space antics.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its solid first set and an especially tight second‑set sequence (Ship of Fools, Estimated Prophet, Eyes of the World) plus relaxed vocals on Casey Jones and a memorable Scarlet. The soundboard tape is described as clear, well‑balanced with fat bass and excellent separation, though a few reviewers note occasional over‑saturation in the loudest moments. Overall the performance and recording are regarded as highly enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars, highlighting strong musical moments and an excellent soundboard mix; only a few low‑star comments note minor issues, leading to a weighted average of ~4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp mix with great separation and fat bass; some listeners mention slight over‑saturation on the loudest parts (motorcycle revs) and occasional tape‑flip timing issues, but overall a clean and balanced recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set with highlights like Shakedown Street and Brent’s Red Rooster; second set flows tightly from Ship of Fools through Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World, ending with a relaxed Casey Jones and an energetic encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Relaxed vocal on Casey Jones praised; generally solid guitar work though not called out specifically.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland highlighted – mic’d up on his Harley, strong vocals on Red Rooster and clear keyboard presence throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart interacts with the biker during drums/space; drum mix noted as clean and powerful, especially during Scarlet.
